meta.title: Company Lens
meta.description: Source-backed company research: filed SEC disclosures, historical market context and grounded answers, each with the evidence it came from.

footer.boundary: Evidence, not prediction. Nothing here is investment advice.
footer.universe: Universe: a convenience sample of current large caps, not a point-in-time index.
footer.sources: SEC filings and adjusted daily prices
footer.fixtures: Development build: synthetic fixture data, not market data.

home.metaDescription: Search a covered company and read its filed disclosures, historical return and risk, recent events and grounded answers.
home.title: Read the evidence before the opinion.
home.lede: Every number on a company page was computed from filed SEC disclosures and adjusted daily prices, and links back to the document it came from.
home.coverage: {companies} companies have a research snapshot in this build. A symbol outside that set gets a stated boundary, never a generated page.
home.fixtureBannerBody: This build is reading synthetic fixtures generated for testing. Issuers named SYNxxx are not real companies and these are not market prices.

search.label: Search by symbol or company name
search.hint: {count} companies covered. Type a symbol and press Enter.
search.noMatchBody: This build holds evidence only for the companies listed below. Nothing is fetched on demand and no page is generated for a company without a snapshot.
search.ambiguous: {count} companies match. Choose one from the list.

home.featuredNote: Three pages to start from. Not a ranking, a recommendation, or a screen result.
home.evidenceNote: Three sources, each with its own time of observation. The research page states how each one is handled.

filings.title: SEC disclosures
filings.body: 8-K items and recent periodic reports, read from EDGAR with their acceptance timestamps kept.

prices.title: Adjusted daily prices
prices.body: Vendor-adjusted daily closes, used for historical return, volatility and drawdown against a stated benchmark.

fundamentals.title: Filed financial results
fundamentals.body: Figures as filed in Company Facts, with the accounting concept, unit and reporting period they belong to.

notFound.title: This company is not in this build.
notFound.body: This build holds research snapshots for {count} companies. Nothing is fetched on demand, so rather than generate a profile from nothing, the page stops here.

company.metaDescription: Filed disclosures, historical return and risk, and grounded answers for {name}.

brief.title: Start here, then verify below.
brief.intro: Three statements, each labelled by what kind of statement it is. Every number in them is linked to its source further down the page.

news.title: Recent headlines
news.intro: Kept in two lists, because a market-wide headline is not evidence about this company.
news.noCompanyNews: No company headlines in this snapshot.
news.noMarketNews: No market headlines in this snapshot.

empty.title: No headlines in this snapshot
empty.body: The headline source is configured but returned nothing for this window. The filings and price history above are unaffected.

news.boundary: Headlines are published wording, kept in the language they were published in.

financials.title: What the latest financial report says
financials.intro: {kind} figures as filed in the {form} for the period ending {periodEnd}, filed {filed}. Read from one filing, so the period and the accounting concept always match the number.
financials.boundary: Consolidated figures as reported. Accounting treatment and business mix differ between companies, and a filed result is not a forecast.

empty.title: No filed financial report in this snapshot
empty.body: No 10-Q or 10-K with usable figures has been cached for this company, so no revenue, income or EPS figure is shown.
empty.footnote: Historical return, risk and SEC disclosures below are unaffected.

metadataOnly.title: Report found, figures not extractable
metadataOnly.body: The filing was located but no figure matched the reporting period and accounting concept this page requires, so nothing is displayed rather than an approximate one.

financials.noPrior: No comparable prior-year period in this filing.

revenue.label: Revenue
revenue.definition: Reported revenue before expenses; not stock performance.

net_income.label: Net income
net_income.definition: Reported net income after expenses and taxes; the exact SEC concept is below.

eps.label: Diluted EPS
eps.definition: Diluted earnings per share; not total profit or a growth rate.

gross_profit.label: Gross profit
gross_profit.definition: Revenue less cost of revenue, in dollars; not gross margin percent.

reference.available: Covered SIC {group} sample median YoY: {median} (n={n}, excluding this company). Gap: {gap} percentage points.

reason.no_company_growth: This company has no comparable growth rate.
reason.missing_classification: The SEC SIC classification is missing.
reason.insufficient_sample: Only {n} eligible companies; at least {minimum} are required.

reference.methodBody: As of {asOf}. Latest cached filings only; one issuer per CIK (share classes deduplicated); SEC SIC first 3 digits, same annual or quarterly grain, exact accounting concept and currency. Period ends within 45 days, durations within 15 days. Later filings, missing comparisons and zero or loss bases are excluded. Equal-weight median of company YoY rates — not aggregate industry growth, a full industry census, or a matched business peer set.

financials.conceptBody: YoY = current ÷ prior-year value − 1, against the same period a year earlier rather than the previous quarter. Percentage-point gap = company growth − sample median growth.
financials.yoyNote: Growth is withheld where the prior base was zero or a loss, because a percentage there is not meaningful.

performance.title: What this has done, and how roughly
performance.intro: Adjusted daily prices over the selected period, against {benchmark}. {benchmarkNote}

benchmarkNote.SPY: SPY is an exchange-traded fund tracking the S&P 500.
benchmarkNote.QQQ: QQQ is an exchange-traded fund tracking the Nasdaq-100, which excludes financial companies; it is not a pure technology index.

unavailable.missing_prices: {symbol} prices are not in this snapshot, so no matched comparison exists.
unavailable.stale_prices: The {symbol} price history ends before this company's does, so the two cannot be compared on matched dates.
unavailable.insufficient_overlap: The two histories share too few matched trading sessions over this period to support return, volatility or drawdown.
unavailable.invalid_values: The matched series contained values that are not finite, so the comparison is withheld rather than shown.

metric.cagrContext: Compound rate over the period shown

performance.riskNote: The worst peak-to-trough fall over this period was {drawdown}, and the worst single session was {worst}. Both already happened; neither bounds what comes next.
performance.coveragePartial: History requested from {requested} but matched prices start {start} and end {end}: {sessions} sessions. Nothing before the earliest shared date is filled in.
performance.scopeNote: Only this section follows the benchmark selector. The brief, filing reactions and Ask evidence stay on {benchmark}; this chart is showing {selected}.
performance.boundary: Past return and risk are observations about a period that is over. They are not a forecast, and nothing here is investment advice.

chart.alt: Growth of an equal investment in {ticker} and {benchmark} from {start} to {end}, ending at {assetEnd} and {benchmarkEnd} respectively.
chart.caption: {ticker} against {benchmark}, {start} to {end}, from {initial} invested at the start of the period.

volatility.title: How wide the next {sessions} sessions may be
volatility.alt: Expected annualised volatility between {low} and {high}, most likely {median}, against this issuer's usual {usual}.
volatility.band: 80% of the time, in this range
volatility.coverage: The 80% band held {value} of outcomes out of sample.
volatility.boundary: A range and a horizon, never a direction: this says how much movement to expect, not which way.

signal.eyebrow: THIS FILING VS ITS OWN HISTORY
signal.title: Is this unusual for this company?
signal.intro: Every number here compares this filing with earlier filings from the same issuer. Nothing compares it with other companies.
signal.probability: chance of an unusually large reaction
signal.base: how often this issuer clears its own bar
signal.boundary: This estimates how large a reaction may be, not which way it goes. It is a reading priority, not investment advice.

filings.title: What was filed
filings.intro: The filings themselves, with what the company disclosed kept apart from what this project measured about it.

empty.title: No filings in this snapshot
empty.body: No 8-K filings have been cached for this company, so nothing is listed rather than a summary of nothing.

filings.timelineNote: Each with the move on the first eligible session afterwards, measured against the benchmark. A measurement of magnitude, not a cause.
filings.noPassages: No passage could be extracted deterministically from the cached primary document, so none is quoted.
filings.comparisonAgainst: Compared with the filing accepted {date}: {changed} changed, {added} added, {removed} removed.
filings.novelty: Novelty against this issuer's past filings: {value}
filings.reactionPercentile: Larger than {value} of this issuer's earlier filings (n={sample})
filings.reactionBoundary: Magnitude only. This does not establish that the filing caused the move.

events.title: What happened, and what to watch

notCovered.title: No event coverage for this company
notCovered.body: {ticker} is outside the set of companies the event refresh currently fetches, so no event feed is published for it.
notCovered.footnote: This is a coverage boundary, not a statement that nothing happened. Filings, financial results and price history on this page are unaffected.

unavailable.title: Event feed currently unavailable
unavailable.body: The published feed could not be read on this request. That is not the same as there being no events.
unavailable.footnote: Everything else on this page is built from the snapshot and is unaffected.

error.title: Event feed could not be loaded
error.body: The request for this company's events did not complete. Nothing is shown rather than a stale or invented list.

initializing.title: First collection in progress
initializing.body: The feed for this company has been created but has not completed a full cycle, so there is nothing published to show yet.

noNew.title: No new items since the last check
noNew.body: The last check succeeded and returned nothing new. Older items keep their original source time.

stale.title: Showing the last good copy
stale.body: Recent checks did not succeed, so what is shown is the most recent feed that did.
stale.bodyWithTime: Recent checks did not succeed. What is shown is the feed from {time}.

noUpcoming.title: No confirmed future dates.
noUpcoming.body: Nothing ahead has a date confirmed by the company or a filing. An expected date is not shown here as a confirmed one.

events.partialGaps: {count} coverage gap(s) recorded for this window.
events.askDisabled: Event questions are disabled while the card and the server are not on the same published feed version.
events.boundary: Event items are published headlines and filing index entries, linked to their source. They are not analysis, and the feed is not a trading signal.

ask.title: Ask about this evidence
ask.intro: Questions are answered from this company's evidence packet alone. Citations and number literals are checked against that packet before an answer is shown, and an answer that fails the check is withheld rather than displayed.
ask.stopped: Stopped before an answer was returned. The request may still finish on the server, but no answer is shown.
ask.originalLanguage: This answer was generated in its own language and is shown as generated. Ask again to generate one in the language you are reading.
ask.rate: {perHour} questions per hour on this public demo.
ask.boundary: No investment advice, price target or directional forecast is produced, and a question asking for one is refused.

field.question: Your question
field.questionPlaceholder: What did {ticker} disclose in its latest filing?

suggest.latest: What did the latest filing disclose?
suggest.history: How does the historical return compare with the benchmark?
suggest.risk: What was the largest drawdown, and when?

step.evidence: One company's filings, filed results and price history are assembled into a fixed evidence packet.
step.citations: Every claim must cite an ID from that packet and reuse its exact numbers.
step.refusal: A claim that cannot be grounded, or a question asking for a price call, is refused rather than answered.

unconfigured.title: Ask is not configured on this deployment
unconfigured.body: No model provider key is available here, so no question can be sent and no answer can be produced.
unconfigured.footnote: The evidence on this page stays readable without it.

configError.title: Ask could not be reached
configError.body: The endpoint that lists available models did not respond, so the form is not shown rather than offering a request that cannot be made.

error.ask_not_configured: This deployment has no evidence bundle, so no grounded answer can be produced here.
error.model_not_available: The selected model is not available.
error.ticker_not_available: This company is not in the evidence bundle.
error.scope_not_available: That evidence scope is not available for this company.
error.question_scope: Ask about the supplied company evidence, not what to buy or a price forecast.
error.origin_not_allowed: This request was not accepted from this origin.
error.rate_limited: This public demo allows a small number of questions each hour.
error.daily_budget_exhausted: This public demo has reached its question budget for today. The evidence on the page stays readable.
error.grounding_validation_failed: The model answer was withheld because it did not pass evidence validation.
error.invalid_json: The request could not be read.
